title: 第2章 菊儿胡同一家人
content_zh:
刘济民家分的房子是东厢房，原木色的大门上面坑坑洼洼。外面实在太冷，刘济民也没多少跟李春燕聊天的心思。

    推开门，刘济民放下东西就朝着屋子中间的煤球炉走去，准备生火。

    李春燕跟着刘济民进了房间，非常熟练地找到火柴，开始帮刘济民生火。

    房间摆设十分简单，刘家从郑市转战三门峡，再来到燕京，多年调动，并没有积攒下太多的家当。

    二十平的东厢房被分成了两个房间，入门的屋子被当成客厅，旁边还有一张小床，素色花纹的床帘拉着。刘济民尽管不用在家里住，但母亲王爱梅觉得应该放张床，万一用得着。

    墙壁是后来用茅草混合着石灰刷的，表皮泛黄，烟熏的地方发黑，有的地方已经掉皮了，露出里面原来的青砖。

    正对着屋门的墙壁前放了一张灰色的木桌，桌子上摆着褐红色的老式暖水瓶，还有几本整齐的泛黄书册，没有任何电器。墙壁上挂着一张教员像，旁边挂着一张相框，是父亲刘振国在三门峡工地上参加大会战及ZL视察工地的黑白照片。

    三门峡水利枢纽是新中国成立后，第一个五年计划期间建设的第一个大型水利工程，可以说是举国之力建成。全国上下团结一心，各级领导时时关注，教员四次听取汇报，ZL三次走上工地，在那里度过八个日夜，鼓舞士气、解决问题。

    高峰时期，黄河两岸的工地上聚集起来了两万多人，喝着黄河水，吃着窝窝头，红旗卷起狂风。

    参与修建“万里黄河第一坝”是刘振国一生最为骄傲的事情，这几张照片被父亲刘振国视作珍宝，几张照片堪比军人的军功章。

    屋子中间除了煤火炉之外，还有三张凳子和一张小方桌，小方桌上的红字隐约可见“大坝工地会战”之类的字样。除此之外，再也没有其他的摆设了。

    家里虽然挣钱的不少，但大哥结婚了，得顾自己的小家。刘振国自从教书之后，工资也下降了一截。每月四十八块钱的基础工资，加上二十年的工龄工资，总共五十八块钱。

    母亲王爱梅在居委会当热心大妈，是义务性质，每个月五六块钱，逢年过节有点米面礼品。

    一家人生活没问题，毕竟这年代最好的大米才一毛八分钱，如津城的小站米，是最好的米，出口标准。一号米和二号米，在一毛二到一毛四之间。猪肉七毛到八毛一斤，蔬菜几分钱。

    但靠着这点工资，买个收音机、电视，那实在是有心无力了。

    刘济民上学算军龄，今年是第五年，津贴涨到了十五块钱。

    十五块钱，这钱搁在后世，扔在地上，刘济民都不一定弯腰。

    可现在，衣食住行，全赖这十五块钱，实在是没多余的钱给家里。

    真实的大杂院生活，可比禽满四合院更鸡零狗碎，也更拥挤，到处都放着东西和加盖的小房子。

    “你们今天没课？”李春燕羡慕地问道，目光不经意间在刘济民的绿军装上流转。

    “没课，我回来转悠一圈儿，你不是也没上班？”刘济民蹲在地上，麻利地将火给引燃了。

    “我上次休息的时候顶了刘姐的班，今天她还我。”李春燕是在新华书店上班，这个时代的铁饭碗之一。
content_en:
The house that Liu Jimin's family shares is in the east wing, and the wooden door is full of holes. It was too cold outside, and Liu Jimin didn't have much thought about chatting with Li Chunyan.

    Opening the door, Liu Jimin put down his things and walked towards the briquette stove in the middle of the room, preparing to light a fire.

    Li Chunyan followed Liu Jimin into the room, found matches very skillfully, and started to help Liu Jimin light the fire.

    The room decoration is very simple. The Liu family moved from Zheng City to Sanmenxia and then to Yanjing. After many years of transfer, they did not accumulate much wealth.

    The 20-square-meter east wing was divided into two rooms. The entrance room was used as a living room. There was a small bed next to it with a plain patterned bed curtain. Although Liu Jimin does not need to live at home, his mother Wang Aimei thinks that there should be a bed in case he needs it.

    The walls were later painted with thatch mixed with lime. The surface was yellowed, blackened by smoke, and the skin had peeled off in some places, revealing the original blue bricks inside.

    There was a gray wooden table placed in front of the wall facing the door. There was an old-fashioned maroon thermos on the table, as well as a few neat yellowed books, without any electrical appliances. There is a portrait of a teacher hanging on the wall, and a framed photo next to it. It is a black-and-white photo of his father Liu Zhenguo participating in a general meeting at the Sanmenxia construction site and ZL inspecting the construction site.

    Sanmenxia Water Conservancy Project is the first large-scale water conservancy project built during the first Five-Year Plan after the founding of the People's Republic of China. It can be said that it was built with the efforts of the whole country. The whole country was united, leaders at all levels paid constant attention, teachers listened to reports four times, and leaders went to the construction site three times, spending eight days and nights there to boost morale and solve problems.

    During the peak period, more than 20,000 people gathered at the construction sites on both sides of the Yellow River, drinking water from the Yellow River and eating steamed buns, while red flags were fluttered in the strong wind.

    Participating in the construction of the "First Dam of the Yellow River" is what Liu Zhenguo is most proud of in his life. These photos are regarded as treasures by his father Liu Zhenguo, and some of them are comparable to military medals of military medals.

    In addition to the coal stove, there are three stools and a small square table in the middle of the room. On the small square table, the words "Battle at the Dam Construction Site" can be faintly seen in red letters. Apart from this, there are no other furnishings.

    Although the family earns a lot of money, the eldest brother is married and has to take care of his own family. Liu Zhenguo's salary has also dropped since he started teaching. The basic salary of forty-eight yuan per month, plus twenty years of service salary, makes a total of fifty-eight yuan.

    My mother, Wang Aimei, works as a warm-hearted aunt in the neighborhood committee on a voluntary basis. She earns five or six yuan a month, and some rice and flour gifts during the holidays.

    The family has no problem living. After all, the best rice in this era only costs 18 cents. For example, Xiaozhan rice in Jincheng is the best rice and has export standards. Rice No. 1 and No. 2 cost between 12 cents and 14 cents. Pork costs 70 to 80 cents per pound, and vegetables cost a few cents.

    But relying on this salary to buy a radio or TV is really powerless.

    Liu Jimin goes to school to count his military age. This is his fifth year, and his allowance has increased to fifteen yuan.

    Fifteen yuan, this money will be left in the future, even if it is thrown on the ground, Liu Jimin will not necessarily bend down.

    But now, all the food, clothing, housing and transportation depend on these fifteen yuan, and there really is no extra money for the family.

    The real life in a large courtyard is more fragmented and more crowded than the Qinman courtyard house, with things and small houses built everywhere.

    "You don't have any classes today?" Li Chunyan asked enviously, her eyes inadvertently moving on Liu Jimin's green military uniform.

    "There's no class. I'll come back for a walk. Aren't you at work too?" Liu Jimin squatted on the ground and lit the fire quickly.

    "I took over Sister Liu's class during the last break, and today she paid me back." Li Chunyan works at Xinhua Bookstore, one of the iron rice bowls of this era.
